meta.source: digest-verified read-only replays of recorded Phase 2E.0 episodes (replay_obs.mjs); no model trained, fitted or modified

thresholds.similarState: |Δ own purse share| ≤ 0.05, |Δ squad| ≤ 1, |Δ overseas| ≤ 1, same keeper need

definition.criticalDecisions: every keeper-lot decision of the affected seat while it still needed a keeper (main round and re-auction), exact observation from the digest-verified replay
definition.safeReferences: keeper-lot decisions (any captured seat/episode among the 15,600 replays, excluding the finding episode) where the seat needed a keeper and FINISHED WITH ONE; matched on phase, progress ±0.05 and seat role
definition.percentile: mid-rank percentile of the dangerous decision's value within its matched safe references (0.5 = typical)
